name: Action Against Hunger USA
mission: Action Against Hunger’s mission is to save the lives of children and their families. We are there for them before and after disaster strikes. We enable people to provide for themselves, see their children grow up strong, and for whole communities to prosper. We constantly search for more effective solutions, while sharing our knowledge and expertise with the world. We push for long-term change.
theoryOfChange: Hunger is predictable, preventable, and treatable. We tackle the root causes of hunger, helping people earn incomes and improve food security.

strengths_deep_dive: Action Against Hunger USA demonstrates clear operational scale across crisis regions. In FY2024, the charity directed <cite id="2">90.4% of expenses to program operations</cite>, beating the <cite id="15">85.7% peer group median</cite>. Field programs span health, nutrition, and water sanitation across <cite id="2">districts in countries like Somalia</cite> and emergency areas globally.
rich_narrative.summary: Action Against Hunger USA operates as a prominent global humanitarian organization dedicated to ending malnutrition and severe food insecurity. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="2">$160,756,238 in total revenue</cite> to fuel direct nutritional, health, and emergency response operations worldwide. The organization maintains strong financial management, directing a <cite id="2">89.7% program expense ratio</cite> toward direct service delivery, which easily exceeds <cite id="15">the 75% industry standard</cite>. Though total revenue experienced a decrease from <cite id="1">FY2023 figures of $201,188,874</cite> down to <cite id="2">$160,756,238 in FY2024</cite>, the charity maintains a strong operating foundation supported by <cite id="15">10.2 months of working capital</cite>.
